description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Krosan Restorer's last ability by tapping it, untapping up to three lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Repeat.
